```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(lmerTest)
library(sjstats)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(naniar)
library(Matrix)
library(effectsize)
library(tidyverse)

citation()
version$version.string
```

#Read in Data
```{r, include=TRUE}
FullTotals <- readRDS("fulltotals.rds")

Week_Totals <- readRDS("weektotals.rds")
```

# SWB - Positive Affect
```{r, include=TRUE}
hist(FullTotals$Daily_PA)

jpeg(file="PADaily.jpeg")
ggplot(FullTotals, aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = Condition, shape = Condition)) + 
    geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean', size = 2) + 
    geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
    labs(#title = "Average Daily Positive Affect by Condition",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
   theme_classic() +
   theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14)) +
   scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))
dev.off()

PAavg <- FullTotals %>% group_by(across(c(Condition, CheckinDay))) %>% 
                       summarise(avg_dailyPA = mean(Daily_PA, na.rm = T),
                                 sd_dailyPA = sd(Daily_PA, na.rm = T),
                                 count = n(),
                                 se = sd_dailyPA / sqrt(count),
                                 CI = (qt(.95, count - 1))*se)
  
PAavg

NAavg <- FullTotals %>% group_by(across(c(Condition, CheckinDay))) %>% 
                       summarise(avg_dailyNA = mean(Daily_NA, na.rm = T),
                                 sd_dailyNA = sd(Daily_NA, na.rm = T),
                                 count = n(),
                                 se = sd_dailyNA / sqrt(count),
                                 CI = (qt(.95, count - 1))*se)
  
NAavg

##graphing linear relationship btwn time and positive affect
ggplot(FullTotals, aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, color = Condition)) + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    #geom_jitter() + #vs. geom_point()
    labs(title = "Linear Regression of Positive Affect across the Intervention by Condition",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
   scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 
   #scale_x_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

##REML= False means we'll be using the full maximum likelihood estimation

#L2 unconditional, L1 fixed slope model
uncondpa <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new + (1| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(uncondpa)
performance::icc(uncondpa) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 unconditional, L1 vary slope model
uncondvaryslopepa <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(uncondvaryslopepa)
performance::icc(uncondvaryslopepa) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

anova(uncondpa, uncondvaryslopepa) #callout: model fit improved significantly w/ random slopes

#L2 Condition, L1 fixed slope model
fixedslopepa <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy + (1| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(fixedslopepa)
performance::icc(fixedslopepa) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model
varyslopepa <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy + (1 + CheckinDay_new | Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(varyslopepa)
performance::icc(varyslopepa) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

anova(fixedslopepa, varyslopepa) #callout: although vary slope model fails to converge, model fit is improved

#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
conditionvaryslopepa <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(conditionvaryslopepa)
performance::icc(conditionvaryslopepa) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

anova(varyslopepa, conditionvaryslopepa) #callout: model fit is improved
```

# SWB - Negative Affect
```{r, include=TRUE}
hist(FullTotals$Daily_NA)

jpeg(file="NADaily.jpeg")
ggplot(FullTotals, aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_NA, group = Condition, shape = Condition)) + 
    geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean', size = 2) + 
    geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
    labs(#title = "Average Daily Negative Affect by Condition",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Negative Affect") +
   theme_classic() +
   theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14)) +
   scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))
dev.off()

##graphing linear relationship btwn time and negative affect
ggplot(FullTotals, aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_NA, color = Condition)) + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    #geom_jitter() + #vs. geom_point()
    labs(title = "Linear Regression of Negative Affect across the Intervention by Condition",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Negative Affect") +
   scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

#L2 unconditional, L1 fixed slope model
uncondna <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new + (1| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(uncondna)
performance::icc(uncondna) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 unconditional, L1 vary slope model
uncondvaryslopena <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(uncondvaryslopena)
performance::icc(uncondvaryslopena) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

anova(uncondna, uncondvaryslopena) #callout: model fit improved significantly w/ random slopes

#L2 Condition, L1 fixed slope model
fixedslopeNA <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy + (1| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(fixedslopeNA)
performance::icc(fixedslopeNA) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model
varyslopeNA <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy + (1 + CheckinDay_new | Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(varyslopeNA)
performance::icc(varyslopeNA) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

anova(fixedslopeNA, varyslopeNA) #callout: while the vary slope model failed to converge, fit was improved

#L2 Condition, L1 fixed slope model & intervention day
conditionfixedslopeNA <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(conditionfixedslopeNA)
performance::icc(conditionfixedslopeNA) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
conditionvaryslopeNA <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(conditionvaryslopeNA)
performance::icc(conditionvaryslopeNA) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)
isSingular(conditionvaryslopeNA)

anova(varyslopeNA, conditionvaryslopeNA) #callout: model fit was improved

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day (ML not FIML based on convergence issues)
MLconditionvaryslopeNA <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = TRUE)
summary(MLconditionvaryslopeNA)
performance::icc(MLconditionvaryslopeNA) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)
```

# Removing Duplicates
```{r, include=TRUE}
#Filterday Day Duplicates
FullTotals_FilterDay <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$DailyCheckInDuplicateOrder <= 1)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
PAmodel_DayFilter <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDay, REML = FALSE)
summary(PAmodel_DayFilter)
performance::icc(PAmodel_DayFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
NAmodel_DayFilter <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new  + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDay, REML = FALSE)
summary(NAmodel_DayFilter)
performance::icc(NAmodel_DayFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day (Using ML not FIML to prevent singular)
MLCurmodel_DayFilter <- lmer(Daily_curiosity ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new  + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDay, REML = TRUE)
summary(MLCurmodel_DayFilter)
isSingular(MLCurmodel_DayFilter) #Singular when use FIML
performance::icc(MLCurmodel_DayFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)


#Filterday Date Duplicates
FullTotals_FilterDate <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$DuplicateDateOrder <= 1)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
PAmodel_DateFilter <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDate, REML = FALSE)
summary(PAmodel_DateFilter)
performance::icc(PAmodel_DateFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
NAmodel_DateFilter <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new  + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDate, REML = FALSE)
summary(NAmodel_DateFilter)
performance::icc(NAmodel_DateFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day
Curmodel_DateFilter <- lmer(Daily_curiosity ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new  + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_FilterDate, REML = FALSE)
summary(Curmodel_DateFilter)
performance::icc(Curmodel_DateFilter) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#Using Recoded Days
FullTotals_RecodedDays <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$Recoded.Day != 0)
FullTotals_RecodedDays$Recoded.Day_new <- FullTotals_RecodedDays$Recoded.Day - 1
hist(FullTotals_RecodedDays$CheckinDay)
describe(FullTotals_RecodedDays)


#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day (removed duplicates)
PAmodel_recode <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*Recoded.Day_new + (1 + Recoded.Day_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_RecodedDays, REML = FALSE)
summary(PAmodel_recode)
performance::icc(PAmodel_recode) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day (removed duplicates)
NAmodel_recode <- lmer(Daily_NA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*Recoded.Day_new  + (1 + Recoded.Day_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_RecodedDays, REML = FALSE)
summary(NAmodel_recode)
performance::icc(NAmodel_recode) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

#L2 condition, L1 vary slope model & intervention day (removed duplicates)
Curmodel_recode <- lmer(Daily_curiosity ~ 1  + condition_dummy*Recoded.Day_new  + (1 + Recoded.Day_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_RecodedDays, REML = FALSE)
summary(Curmodel_recode)
performance::icc(Curmodel_recode) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

```
# Daily PA Moderators
```{r, include=TRUE}
#Social
#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & social
conditionXsocial <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new*overall_social + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(conditionXsocial)
class(conditionXsocial)
performance::icc(conditionXsocial) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)
emmeans::emmeans(conditionXsocial, pairwise ~ condition_dummy * overall_social)

trends <- emmeans::emtrends(conditionXsocial, var = "CheckinDay_new", specs = c("condition_dummy", "overall_social"))
emmeans::contrast(trends, method = "pairwise")


FullTotals_Curiosity <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$condition_dummy == 1)
ggplot(FullTotals_Curiosity, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) + 
       geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       labs(title = "Curiosity Condition Average Daily Positive Affect When Social",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
       scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

ggplot(FullTotals_Curiosity, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) + 
       geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Curiosity Condition Positive Affect When Social",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 

FullTotals_Control <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$condition_dummy == 0)
ggplot(FullTotals_Control, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) + 
       geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       labs(title = "Control Condition Average Daily Positive Affect When Social",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
       scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

ggplot(FullTotals_Control, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) + 
       geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Control Condition Positive Affect When Social",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 

#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & social (Examining Interaction by breaking out condition)
curiosityXsocial_cur <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new*overall_social + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_Curiosity, REML = FALSE)
summary(curiosityXsocial_cur)

#Dummy codes
curiosityXsocial_dummy <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + controlgroup_social*CheckinDay_new 
                                             + curiositygroup_NOsocial*CheckinDay_new 
                                             + curiositygroup_social*CheckinDay_new 
                                             + (1  + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(curiosityXsocial_dummy)

ggplot(FullTotals, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social_name, color = overall_social_name)) + 
       geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       labs(title = "Average Daily Positive Affect When Social by Condition",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
       scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

ggplot(FullTotals, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_social_name, color = overall_social_name)) + 
       geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Positive Affect By Condition When Social",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 

#Novelty
#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & novelty
conditionXnovelty <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new*overall_novelty + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = TRUE)
summary(conditionXnovelty)
performance::icc(conditionXnovelty) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

ggplot(FullTotals_Curiosity, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_novelty, color = overall_novelty)) +

       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Curiosity Condition Positive Affect When Novel Behavior",

      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 

ggplot(FullTotals_Control, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_novelty, color = overall_novelty)) +

       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') +

       x = "Intervention Day",

ggplot(FullTotals_Control, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_PA, group = overall_novelty, color = overall_novelty)) + 
       geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Control Condition Positive Affect When Novel Behavior",
       x = "Day",
       y = "Positive Affect") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7)) 

#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & social (Examining Interaction by breaking out condition)
curiosityXnovel_cur <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new*overall_novelty + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_Curiosity, REML = FALSE)
summary(curiosityXnovel_cur)

curiosityXnovel_con <- lmer(Daily_PA ~ 1  + CheckinDay_new*overall_novelty + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals_Control, REML = FALSE)
```

# Daily Curiosity Moderators

```{r, include=TRUE}
#Social
#L2 Condition, L1 vary slope model & social
conditionXsocial_cur <- lmer(Daily_curiosity ~ 1  + condition_dummy*CheckinDay_new*overall_social + (1 + CheckinDay_new| Participant.ID), data=FullTotals, REML = FALSE)
summary(conditionXsocial_cur)
performance::icc(conditionXsocial_cur) ##proportion of variance between participants (level 2)

emmeans::emmeans(conditionXsocial_cur, pairwise ~ condition_dummy * overall_social)

trends2 <- emmeans::emtrends(conditionXsocial_cur, var = "CheckinDay_new", specs = c("condition_dummy", "overall_social"))
emmeans::contrast(trends2, method = "pairwise")


FullTotals_Curiosity <- FullTotals %>% filter(FullTotals$condition_dummy == 1)
ggplot(FullTotals_Curiosity, 
       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_curiosity, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) + 
       geom_point(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       geom_line(stat = 'summary', fun = 'mean') + 
       labs(title = "Curiosity Condition Average Daily Curiosity Rating When Social",
       x = "Intervention Day",
       y = "Curiosity Rating") +
       scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))

       aes(x = CheckinDay, y = Daily_curiosity, group = overall_social, color = overall_social)) +

       labs(title = "Linear Regression of Curiosity Condition Curiosity Rating When Social",

      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7))
```
